stories.s: The City Council adopted the biennial budget, closing a $40 million general fund deficit. It adds 12 police officers and a 10% commercial parking tax, cuts more than 100 positions and phases out the HOPE team.

stories.h: Chinook, Cayuse passes close for season today
stories.s: SR 410 over Chinook Pass and SR 123 over Cayuse Pass close for the winter starting Wednesday, Nov. 18, at 10 a.m.

stories.h: $1 million bail in deadly Spanaway chase crash
stories.s: A judge set $1 million bail for Brody Wood, 20, accused of killing David Bauschman, 54, after a chase that hit 134 mph. Police say his blood alcohol level was 0.109.

stories.h: Fox Island Bridge replacement worries nearby homeowners
stories.s: Pierce County's replacement of the structurally deficient 1954 bridge could cost more than $250 million. Property buying could start in 2029, and residents say the uncertainty is hurting home sales.

coming.h: Fantasy Lights Walk at Spanaway Park
coming.s: Walk-through nights for Pierce County's holiday light display, with sessions at 4:30 and 7 p.m. Admission is $3–$5. The drive-through season opens Nov. 27.
